The Updates page installs system updates: The Updates page installs system updates and lets you return to the previous version if an update causes trouble.
Programs is where you install and start: Programs is where you install and start Windows programs. Games has settings for Steam and other game tools.
File backup shows saved copies of your f: File backup shows saved copies of your files. Feedback is the place to ask for help, and Disks can help bring files over from Windows.

Create a Sloth OS USB installer: Create a Sloth OS USB installer
Download the Sloth OS ISO, then write it: Download the Sloth OS ISO, then write it to a USB drive with Fedora Media Writer or Rufus. Follow the illustrated guide for the exact steps and boot menu keys.
Writing the ISO erases everything on the: Writing the ISO erases everything on the selected USB drive. Check the drive name and size carefully, and copy any files you want to keep before you start.
After writing the USB drive, restart the: After writing the USB drive, restart the computer and choose the USB device from its boot menu.
